hero.name: Marden Resende Andrade
hero.tagline: I test and build software with the same care: I work as a QA engineer (manual and automated testing) and as a full stack developer, bringing quality assurance and code together in one profile.

about.title: Who I am
paragraphs: I started programming in college, studying Computer Science, and quickly moved from theory into practice: I built personal and academic projects in Java, C, C++, and Pascal just to really understand how software is built, without shortcuts from AI. That's where programming logic became second nature to me — and also where I discovered I enjoy both building systems and making sure they actually work.

Today I work as a QA engineer on a system built entirely in Java, doing manual testing and automated testing with Python and Selenium, and in my spare time I also take on development tasks on that same system — which has given me a full view of the software lifecycle. I prefer being on the development side, especially with Java and Spring Boot, but it's as a QA engineer that I've been standing out: I've been recognized for reducing the bug rate per release and for building my own QA platform, using AI to generate test scenarios and integrating directly with Jira, now adopted by my team.

items.title: Plataforma QA
items.description: A platform I built to centralize and document all the manual tests I run as a QA engineer. It uses AI to automatically generate test scenarios and integrates directly with Jira — creating subtasks, marking them as done, and more — removing repetitive manual work. It was praised by my lead and teammates.

items.title: FinUp
items.description: A personal finance management system, built as a university extension project for a real client. I was responsible for full stack development and the full delivery cycle: requirements gathering with the client, demos, and testing.

items.title: Accounting Expert System
items.description: An expert system built as a university extension project to help a company understand its tax situation. A real-client project, including delivery, demos, and testing following standard software engineering practices.

items.title: Recurring Payments Management
items.description: A system to manage recurring payments for a Muay Thai gym, built as a university extension project for a real client, with deliveries and testing closely followed by the client.

items.title: Atividade Atleta
items.description: A ticket-selling system for running races, built with a friend, with payments integrated directly via Mercado Pago. A personal project taken from scratch to real production, serving real customers.
